evidencePolicy.supportMeaning: A declared version is a reproducible target, not a support claim. Support begins only after the lane's real Next fixture and smoke evidence are green.

typescript.selection: Pinned to the exact version shared by the observed genes-ts and Next.js source manifests; Next stable accepts workspace-owned TypeScript.

genesTs.name: genes-ts
genesTs.baselineReason: The exact immutable v1.50.0 commit preserves Haxe-checked HXX, direct JSX, strict boundary types, declarations, source maps, TypeScript 5/6/7, and classic JavaScript. It adds a small compiler-data helper that lets trusted macros return private bytes to a development host before publication. It also retains the generic closed CSS Module imports, module-level React components, typed JavaScript Array operations, and other compiler improvements from earlier releases. NextJsHx consumes these generic capabilities and keeps only Next.js graph, adapter, route, and error policy here. The full Genes release suite passed on the exact release commit. NextJsHx also checks the exact pin through Haxe, strict TypeScript, production Next builds, server behavior, and browser behavior.

lanes.purpose: Release-blocking compatibility lane using the exact published stable Next.js package and both supported Node CI versions.
Non-blocking declaration early warning against an exact read-only Next.js source checkout or exact published canary package.

runtimes.name: Node.js
runtimes.reason: The first supported App Router vertical slices target the standard Next.js Node runtime.

runtimes.name: Edge Runtime
runtimes.reason: Edge compatibility requires a separate API and runtime audit and is not part of the initial support claim.

bundlers.name: Turbopack
bundlers.reason: The pinned stable Next.js release uses the framework's current default bundler path, verified on both supported Node versions.

bundlers.name: webpack
bundlers.reason: The same stable production fixture and smoke contract run as a blocking compatibility lane on both supported Node versions.

included: Explicit client components and Server Functions
Version-gated [React 19 Flight](react-flight.md) Date, Map, Set, typed-buffer, global-symbol, server-Promise, Server Function prop, and desktop/mobile Suspense streaming capabilities
Typed loading, error, and not-found convention files
Typed metadata, generated static params, and stable literal segment config
Published stable Next.js package as the blocking lane
exclusions: Replacing the Next.js runtime, router, compiler, or bundler
Implicit ownership of native TypeScript or JavaScript route files
A public compatibility promise before real fixture evidence exists
